description: Classify a spend extract, verify that the generated CSV preserves every source row, then compare it with supplied approved suppliers, contracts and POs. Fixed sequence: classification (xspend-taxonomy, $15) → exceptions (xmaverick-detector, $15). Separate invoices per stage; completed stages remain consumed if a later stage fails. No atomic bundle charge or automatic transfer.

consentExternalProcessing.description: Required: authorize external processing for this workflow.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller key for exactly one logical workflow request.

maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum charge authorized across the recipe. Direct prepaid stages need their own supplied invoices; enabled native marketplace billing requires verified platform authorization.

fxEvidence.description: Dated FX rates; no automatic currency conversion (optional)

activeContracts.description: Active contracts and price references CSV / YAML (required)

approvalPolicy.description: Buyer approval thresholds; defaults remain provisional (optional)

name: procurement_workflow__spend_to_compliance
title: Classify spend → purchasing exceptions
